details.description: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is DeepSeek's flagship mixture-of-experts chat model, released August 13, 2026 as the official general-availability version of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, superseding an earlier preview with what DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card describes as 'greatly enhanced agentic capabilities and performance improvements' especially in production use. It has 1.7 trillion parameters, a roughly 1,000,000-token context window, three reasoning-effort levels (low, high, max), and a DSpark speculative-decoding module, with native OpenAI Responses API support optimized for Codex integration. DeepSeek's own DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash launch announcement states that, starting September 14, 2026, all deepseek-v4-pro API requests are automatically routed to the newer, smaller DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash's rates, effectively retiring this release for new traffic.
advantages: Scores 87.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, an agentic terminal-use benchmark, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Resolves 83.3% of tasks on CyberGym, a cybersecurity-research agent benchmark.
Scores 60.0 on Humanity's Last Exam when allowed to use tools.
Supports a roughly 1,000,000-token context window with three reasoning-effort levels (low, high, max) to trade off latency against depth.
Includes native OpenAI Responses API support optimized for Codex, per DeepSeek's launch announcement.
disadvantages: Text only; no image or audio input, per the catalog's recorded modality.
DeepSeek has routed all deepseek-v4-pro API requests to the newer, cheaper DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash since September 14, 2026, effectively retiring this model for new traffic.
This dated snapshot is scheduled for removal from third-party hosts, per the catalog's provider deprecation dates.
use_cases: Long-horizon agentic coding, with native OpenAI Responses API support optimized for Codex integration.
Tool-augmented reasoning and knowledge tasks (Humanity's Last Exam with tools).
Long-context document or codebase analysis using up to a roughly 1,000,000-token context window.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release | DeepSeek API Docs

notes: The Hugging Face card for this specific dated snapshot (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) states '1.7T params' without a separate active-parameter figure, differing from the 1.6T-total/49B-active figures on the generic 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro' card used for the sibling slug deepseek-v4-pro (likely an earlier preview-era card); this entry uses the 0813-specific figure since it is the one about this exact release. Catalog's modality (text only) and max_input_tokens (1,048,576) match Together AI's page for this exact model id; catalog's max_output_tokens (131,072) is the provider-side cap, lower than the 384K DeepSeek recommends at high/max reasoning effort, so the description covers context window only. Evaluation scores are this model's own agentic-benchmark table on its Hugging Face card, not the different benchmark set on the generic DeepSeek-V4-Pro card.
